test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No.3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Again'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the passage,** it is **mentioned that **the Games were held every four years from 1924 until 1936, after which they were (blank No. 1) by World War II.
 
• The Olympics (blank No. 2) in 1948 and was (blank No. 3) held every four years.
 
• The word** "again"** accurately reflects that the Olympics resumed being held every four years after the pause caused by World War II.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *The Olympics **resumed **in 1948 and was **again **held every four years. Until 1992, the Winter and Summer Olympic Games were held in the same years,*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) "regain"** means to recover or obtain again, but it does not convey the idea of the Olympics being held every four years after the interruption.
 
• **Option 3) "bargained"** means to negotiate or make an agreement, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4) "never"** implies that the Olympics were never held again every four years, which contradicts the information provided in the passage.
